title: Coverage Tenure in Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Hardship Assistance
content:
**Training questions and answers on the coverage-tenure points of Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility hardship assistance.**

**What adds coverage-tenure points?** The whole calendar months between the coverage record's effective date and the handling date, on an account whose hardship approval is in force. The points are added to the hardship assistance percentage.

**How many points?**

| Whole calendar months since the coverage record's effective date | Points |
|---|---|
| at least 60 | 3 |
| at least 24 but fewer than 60 | 1 |
| fewer than 24 | 0 |

**Which record's effective date?** The effective date of the coverage record that carries the charge — this coverage account, not another coverage the patient holds.

**Are the points a separate discount?** No. They are percentage points added to the assistance percentage, which is applied once.

**Boundary illustrations (hypothetical).**

| Months held | Points |
|---|---|
| 23 | 0 |
| 24 | 1 |
| 59 | 1 |
| 60 | 3 |
